headline: TI authors propose a handoff from schematic annotations to analog functional coverage
fact: A TI-authored paper proposes an Analog Coverage Collector through which analog designers mark internal schematic and device threshold information for use by chip-level verification engineers. The paper describes turning that information into top-level covergroups and coverage data to coordinate analog design and verification work.

sources.title: Functional Coverage Collection for Analog Circuits: Enabling Seamless Collaboration Between Design and Verification
sources.summary: TI-authored 2016 paper proposing schematic-level annotations that feed top-level analog functional coverage.
